sinopsis.es: Una aproximación analítica al trabajo del artista Rosemberg Sandoval, cuya producción abarca desde 1980 hasta la actualidad y se caracteriza por el uso del cuerpo propio y ajeno, especialmente de habitantes de calle, como material artístico.
sinopsis.en: In the early 1990s, Colombian artist Rosemberg Sandoval created a mural that, like many of his other works, was transgressive, and ultimately destroyed. Today, the only evidence of its existence lies in the photographic record made by an anonymous person from Tijuana who was traveling through Colombia at the time. The documentary traces these images through the photographer's footsteps, in a journey across time of one of Latin America's most incisive artists.
